text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - lyonesse dedicated pool GPU queue length > 120 for 5m, tail latency degrading. Alerting oncall.

pagerduty: Paging sophia (oncall) for incident 2109876543 - please acknowledge.

sophia (oncall): ack. looking into lyonesse dedicated pool. seeing long queues on GPU-0/1.

marta (eng-sre): saw spike starting ~2109871500, looks like a batch job from lyonesse ingestion. Their qps jumped x6. metrics: gpu_util=98%, queue=130, 95p latency=3.2s.

rahul: confirming it's single-tenant dedicated pool for lyonesse (VPC). no other tenants to evict. autoscale policy shows reserved cap=4 gpus, burst disabled.

sophia (oncall): can we enable short-term burst? what's approval path?

marta (eng-sre): we can toggle manual-burst for up to 2 extra GPUs for 30m. needs ops-lead or exec signoff for charge beyond committed cap.

eli (acct mgr): @sophia I alerted Lyonesse CS. They're seeing 5xxs in their app and are on standby. They'll accept a temporary fallback if we can route heavy batch to a lower-cost model.

rahul: suggestion: enable manual-burst + apply immediate routing policy to divert queries with body.size > 50k to quantized-ggml variant (lower mem, higher throughput). That reduces KV pressure. quick command: 

```
# enable 2-gpu burst for tenant lyonesse
redwoodctl reserved burst --tenant lyonesse --add-gpus 2 --duration 30m
# add routing rule to fallback model
redwoodctl routing set --tenant lyonesse --rule "if request.size>50k -> model=lyonesse/ggml-q4_ren" --priority 10
```

sophia (oncall): running burst cmd now.

deploy-bot: Executing: redwoodctl reserved burst --tenant lyonesse --add-gpus 2 --duration 30m --requested-by sophia

deploy-bot: Success. Burst capacity online: +2 GPUs. Pool now at 6 GPUs.

marta (eng-sre): applying routing rule in 30s. expected immediate drop in queue length as large requests move to q4 path. also enabling aggressive prefix caching for lyonesse.

rahul: metrics after 90s: queue=36, gpu_util=82%, 95p latency=720ms. no further 5xxs reported from lyonesse app.

eli (acct mgr): Lyonesse confirmed reduced errors and will throttle their nightly job; they asked for a postmortem and cost delta. I've told them we'll follow up with exact minutes and pricing impact.

sophia (oncall): incident status -> mitigated via burst + model fallback. still monitoring for 15m. action items: 1) marta to create quick runbook note for manual-burst steps, 2) rahul to capture cost delta and annotate commit, 3) eli to prepare customer-facing summary.

marta (eng-sre): will add runbook snippet to incident and propose an automated rule: when single-tenant dedicated pool queue > 80 for 3m and autoscale disabled, auto-enable 1-gpu burst with notif. PR to infra in morning.

rahul: logging cost delta: +2gpus * 30m -> estimate $X (placeholder), will update once billing calc available.

sophia (oncall): handing off to marta for post-incident cleanup at 2109876860. I'll remain reachable if it reappears.

incident-bot: Incident 2109876543 moved to MONITORED. Tags: dedicated, single-tenant, burst, fallback, customer-impact.
